note: Generation briefs for the Agent Briefing art-review pipeline. Final image prompt = styleGuide.positive + asset brief fields + compositionConstraints + technical line + styleGuide.negative. Codex composes and may add technical/format wording, but must not rewrite the creative content of these briefs.

styleGuide.positive: Polished 2D Japanese anime / light-novel game illustration. Clean confident linework, soft cel shading with gentle gradient lighting, cinematic rim light, rich saturated but not garish color. Family-friendly modern espionage and intelligence-agency atmosphere: deep navy blue, gunmetal, brushed steel, warm amber and gold accents, cool glowing displays. Designed to appeal to Japanese elementary school students aged 8 to 12 - warm, expressive, slightly stylized proportions, characters who read as competent and cool rather than cute-for-cuteness. High production value, cinematic, modern mobile-game key-art quality.
styleGuide.negative: Do not use: flat vector cutout shapes, South Park style, simple geometric paper-doll characters, thick uniform outlines with no shading, generic corporate clip art, stock-illustration flat design, photorealism, 3D render or CGI look, western Cartoon-Network style, chibi or toddler proportions, babyish art. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, signatures, captions, speech bubbles, UI elements, borders, frames, or turnaround / multi-view sheets in the image. No weapons, no violence, no realistic firearms.
styleGuide.consistency: All assets belong to one fictional agency and must look drawn by the same artist in the same production: identical linework weight, identical shading approach, identical palette family, identical level of detail.

openQuestions.question: The Agent ID screen lets each student customize skin / hair / suit / tie / sunglasses, which works because the avatar is parametric SVG. A painted raster avatar cannot be recolored per student. Options: (a) keep the SVG avatar and skip raster replacement for it, (b) generate a small set of painted avatar presets and change the Agent ID screen from parameter pickers to preset picking, (c) one canonical painted avatar and retire customization.
openQuestions.doesNotBlock: building the pipeline, or generating base avatar candidates
openQuestions.claudeRecommendation: (b) - keeps student ownership, which is the motivational point of the Agent ID screen, and painted presets look far better than parametric recolor. Decide at review time.
openQuestions.answer: (b) painted presets. Four presets, sharing one identical pose, camera, crop, suit and lighting so they read as one squad. The Agent ID screen becomes a preset picker. That UI change is deferred until approved preset art exists - do not degrade the working customizer before there is art to replace it with.

openQuestions.question: The agency logo currently has a live rotating radar sweep animated in SVG. A raster logo loses it unless the sweep stays as a CSS overlay on top of the image.
openQuestions.claudeRecommendation: Generate candidates for comparison, but 'Keep Existing' is a strong default here - a clean vector emblem is not the crude-cutout problem we are solving.
openQuestions.answer: Keep Existing. The SVG emblem stays as-is and is dropped from the generation queue entirely - do not generate candidates for it.

phases.1: Anchor pass. Establishes the visual direction. Generate and review these first.
phases.2: Gated on phase 1 approvals - remaining dossier portraits and NPC back views, generated using the approved phase 1 art as a reference image.
phases.3: Gated on a locked canonical design - animation variants only.

assets.name: Headquarters Briefing Room
assets.sourceRef: styles.css .room-wall / .conf-table - currently a CSS gradient and a CSS-drawn table
assets.purpose: The room the student's agent walks into to deliver the mission briefing. It is on screen for the entire climax of the game.

brief.subject: The interior of a modern secret intelligence agency briefing room, empty of people.
brief.environment: A wide underground command room. Dark navy panelled walls with recessed amber strip lighting. Subtle holographic world-map glow and faint data readouts on the side walls, dim and out of focus. A polished dark wood and steel conference table sweeping across the bottom foreground. Cool blue key light from a large wall display area, warm amber fill from side sconces.
brief.camera: Eye-level wide cinematic shot, symmetrical, slight perspective toward the far wall.
brief.crop: Full room, floor visible in the lower third, ceiling implied at the very top.
brief.lighting: Cinematic, moody but not dark or scary. Warm and safe, like a heroic mission-briefing scene in a family animated film.
brief.negativeSpace: CRITICAL - the upper centre of the frame must be a plain, unlit, uncluttered wall area, because a bright projector-screen UI panel is overlaid there occupying the centre 44 percent of the width from 8 to 66 percent of the height. The lower third must stay dark and low-contrast because characters and a table are composited over it.

compositionConstraints: Centre-top 44% x 58% region: keep flat, dark, detail-free. A UI projector panel sits exactly there.
Left edge, lower half: keep clear - the player's agent stands at approximately 9% from the left.
Right side, lower half: keep clear - the commander stands there.
Bottom 34%: will be covered by a conference table; keep it simple and dark.
No focal point or bright highlight anywhere text or characters will sit. The room must recede behind the UI, never compete with it.
No people. No chairs occupying the character positions.

assets.name: Briefing Room Commander
assets.usedIn: Final Headquarters Debrief - right side of the conference table
assets.purpose: Senior intelligence officer who listens to the student's presentation and reacts. His approval is the emotional payoff of the game.

brief.subject: A distinguished male intelligence-agency commander, the head of the department.
brief.pose: Standing behind a conference table, upper body only, squared toward the viewer, hands not visible or resting lightly out of frame. Calm and still - he is listening, not speaking.
brief.expression: Composed and quietly attentive. Warm authority. A faint approving steadiness. Not stern, not scowling, not grinning.
brief.camera: Eye-level, straight-on front view, medium shot.
brief.crop: From roughly mid-chest upward. Head fully in frame with a little headroom.
brief.clothing: Immaculate dark navy double-breasted officer's dress uniform with gold shoulder braid, crisp white shirt, deep burgundy tie, a single gold star insignia on the chest. No readable insignia lettering.
brief.features: Neat silver-grey hair, a trimmed silver moustache, strong kind eyes.
brief.lighting: Soft cool key from the front-left, warm amber rim light from the right, matching the briefing room.

compositionConstraints: Isolated on a fully transparent background - no floor, no room, no shadow plate.
Perfectly upright and centred, so reaction variants can be swapped in without the sprite shifting.
Face large and clear enough to read expression at approximately 170px wide.

animationVariants.rule: Identical identity, hair, uniform, body position, camera, crop, lighting and canvas dimensions. Only the eyes, head tilt and brow change.

assets.name: Player Agent Avatar - Preset 1 (STYLE ANCHOR)
assets.role: STYLE ANCHOR for all four selectable avatar presets
assets.usedIn: Agent ID customization screen, and standing at the podium delivering the debrief in the student's own recorded voice
assets.purpose: The student's own on-screen self. It lip-syncs to their real recorded English. This is the character the student identifies with. Resolved design: the student picks one of four painted presets rather than adjusting colour parameters.

brief.subject: A young rookie secret agent - the hero the player becomes. Preset 1: a boy with short neat black hair and warm light skin.
brief.age: Around 11 to 12 years old. Clearly a confident kid: not an adult, not a toddler.
brief.pose: Standing full body, feet apart and planted, shoulders back, chin level. Confident and ready to give a report. Arms relaxed at the sides. Facing forward.
brief.expression: Bright, determined, a little proud. Eyes open, mouth closed in a small confident line.
brief.camera: Eye-level, straight-on front view, full body.
brief.crop: Head to feet with small margins. The head occupies roughly the top fifth of the frame.
brief.clothing: A sharp kid-sized charcoal-navy agent suit, white shirt, amber-gold tie, a small gold agency pin on the lapel. Optional dark sunglasses.
brief.lighting: Soft front key, subtle amber rim matching the briefing room.

compositionConstraints: Fully transparent background, no shadow, no floor.
Perfectly symmetrical straight-on stance, dead-centred, because facial animation overlays must register exactly.
The face must be drawn clean and unobstructed - eyes and mouth will be replaced by animation overlays.
Head large enough that the mouth reads clearly at 130px total sprite width.

animationVariants.gatedOn: each preset's base design locked by the user
animationVariants.preferred: separate transparent facial overlays registered to the base: avatar_base, eyes_open, eyes_closed, mouth_closed, mouth_small, mouth_medium, mouth_wide
animationVariants.fallback: full-frame variants if overlays cannot register cleanly
animationVariants.rule: Identity, body pose, head position, hair, clothing, proportions, camera, crop, lighting and canvas dimensions must be pixel-stable across every frame. The character must never visibly redraw or jump between states.
animationVariants.claudeNoteForPhase3: Do not assume these overlays must be image-generated. Getting ChatGPT to produce pixel-registered facial overlays across seven frames is the least reliable step in this whole pipeline. The likely better approach is to generate only the neutral painted base per preset, then drive the eyes and mouth with a small drawn overlay positioned over the painted face - which keeps registration exact, costs nothing per frame, and reuses the existing Art.setMouth machinery. Evaluate both before committing.

brief.subject: An ID-photo style portrait of Ben, a friendly elementary-school boy who is the agency's harmless 'person of interest'.
brief.pose: Head and shoulders, squared to camera, an official identification photograph.
brief.expression: Open and kind, with a small natural smile. He is likeable - the joke of the game is that this dramatic dossier is about a nice kid who likes soccer.
brief.crop: Head and upper shoulders, centred, small headroom.
brief.clothing: A bright red casual t-shirt or polo.
brief.features: Short warm brown hair, light-warm skin, brown eyes.
brief.environment: A flat, evenly lit, desaturated blue-grey studio backdrop, like a school or agency ID photo.

Face clearly readable at 150px wide.
Backdrop flat and uniform. No gradient banding, no props, no text.

assets.name: Dossier Portraits - Mia, Leo, Emma, Sam, Lily
assets.gatedOn: dossier_ben approved - the approved Ben image is passed as the style reference image
assets.usedIn: Intelligence Archive wall, Dossier detail, projector
assets.purpose: The other five Persons of Interest.

sharedBrief.framing: This portrait joins a set of six ID photos and must be indistinguishable in treatment from the attached approved Ben portrait: same painter, same linework weight, same soft cel shading, same painterly hair rendering with fine individual strands and a cool blue rim light along the hair edge, same large warm anime eyes with a single soft catchlight each, same light scatter of rosy colour on the cheeks, same age band. Only the individual described below changes.
sharedBrief.pose: Head and upper shoulders, squared to camera, head tilted a few degrees off dead-centre - a relaxed school-ID-photo posture, never a stiff mugshot.
sharedBrief.camera: Straight-on, eye-level, ID-photo framing, natural 50mm-equivalent compression. Head the same size and at the same height in frame as Ben's, so the six cards line up on the archive wall.
sharedBrief.crop: Head and upper shoulders, centred, small headroom above the hair, shirt collar and shoulders visible at the bottom edge exactly like Ben's.
sharedBrief.clothing: A plain crew-neck t-shirt in the character's signature colour, ribbed collar sitting naturally. No logos, prints or text.
sharedBrief.lighting: Soft even key from slightly above camera-left, gentle falloff to camera-right, cool blue rim light on the hair edge - matched to the Ben reference.
sharedBrief.environment: The exact same backdrop as the attached Ben reference: a smooth slate-blue studio backdrop, brightest directly behind the head and falling off slightly darker toward the corners. Match its hue and brightness, not a grey or a different blue.

subjects.brief: Mia (codename PINK PANDA), a girl around 10. Dark chocolate-brown chin-length bob with a soft blunt fringe, fair-warm peach skin, dark brown eyes. Funny and playful: a bright mischievous grin showing a hint of top teeth, eyes slightly crinkled as if she is about to laugh, one eyebrow raised a touch. Bubblegum-pink t-shirt (#ff6fa5).

Leo (codename TURBO TIGER), a boy around 10. Near-black spiky hair swept up and back in bold anime spikes, warm golden-tan skin, dark brown eyes. Brave and energetic: a bold confident grin, chin lifted slightly, eyebrows set with determination - the kid who volunteers first. Bright tangerine-orange t-shirt (#f39c12).

Emma (codename SMART OWL), a girl around 10. Long straight honey-blonde hair falling past her shoulders with a neat side part, fair skin, light brown eyes behind thin round wire-frame glasses that catch a small rim-light glint. Smart and calm: a quiet knowing closed-lip smile, eyes steady and thoughtful. Soft amethyst-purple t-shirt (#9b59b6).

Sam (codename JET SHARK), a boy around 10. Short black hair with tight natural curls, warm medium-brown skin, dark brown eyes. Friendly and easygoing: a wide, open, genuine smile, cheeks lifted, the kid everyone wants on their team. Teal-green t-shirt (#16a085).

Lily (codename SUNNY BEE), a girl around 10. Long very dark brown hair, nearly black, worn loose with a few strands tucked behind one ear, light-warm skin, dark brown eyes. Happy and gentle: a sunny, soft, open-mouthed smile, eyes bright and warm. Sunflower-yellow t-shirt (#f4c518).
